description: The run-quality-gate skill invokes the ns-gate binary to run the deterministic quality checks over a chapter and surface block or warn verdicts.

cases.given: run-quality-gate is invoked on a chapter with all checks passing
cases.expect: ns-gate is invoked via Bash and returns exit 0 with a pass verdict

cases.given: run-quality-gate is invoked on a chapter with an uncovered claim in block mode
cases.expect: ns-gate is invoked via Bash and returns exit 1 with a block verdict identifying the failing check
